name: Solitaire Towers Tournaments
description: Do you play Classic Solitaire, Pyramid, FreeCell, Mahjong, Spider, TriPeaks, or other card puzzle games? Solitaire fans will love Solitaire Towers Tournaments (also known as Towers, TriPeaks, Triple Peaks, or Three Peaks). It’s a relaxing yet challenging free card puzzle game with fresh, unique twists on classic solitaire.
